name: Common Paper Legal Agreement Templates
description: Standard-form legal agreement templates published by Common Paper, curated as the seed dataset for Prelegal. Each entry maps to a Markdown file in the templates/ directory.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
templates.description: Standard Terms for a two-way NDA, letting each party disclose confidential information for an agreed Purpose. Covers use and protection of confidential information, exceptions, disclosures required by law, term and termination, return or destruction of materials, proprietary rights, and equitable relief.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
templates.description: Fill-in-the-blank cover page that incorporates the MNDA Standard Terms by reference. Captures the Purpose, effective date, MNDA term, term of confidentiality, governing law and jurisdiction, and any modifications to the Standard Terms.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for a subscription cloud/SaaS service. Covers access and use rights, restrictions and customer obligations, privacy and security, payment and taxes, term and termination, warranties and disclaimers, limitation of liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Uptime and support commitments that supplement a cloud service agreement. Covers target uptime and how availability is calculated, support response times by priority, and remedies such as service credits.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Data protection addendum governing the processing of personal data. Covers processor and subprocessor relationships, processing instructions, restricted international transfers, security incident response, audits and reports, deletion of customer personal data, and limitation of liability.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Early-access arrangement between a provider and a design partner. Covers product access and program participation, feedback, fees and costs, term and termination, confidentiality, and intellectual property ownership.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Framework for delivering professional services under Statements of Work. Covers SOW mechanics and customer policies, intellectual property in deliverables, privacy and security, payment and taxes, warranties, liability, indemnification, insurance, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Commercial partnership terms between two companies. Covers each party's obligations and feedback, payment and taxes, trademark licensing, privacy, an escalation procedure for disputes, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA business associate agreement governing a provider's handling of protected health information. Covers business associate and company obligations, permitted uses and disclosures, data rights and restrictions, breach notification, and term and termination.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for licensing installed or on-premise software. Covers the license grant and permitted uses, restrictions and obligations, payment and taxes, term and termination, warranties and disclaimers, limitation of liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Time-boxed product pilot or evaluation. Covers pilot access and license grant for evaluation purposes, the pilot period, term and termination, representations, disclaimers, limitation of liability, and confidentiality.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum that layers AI-specific terms onto an existing product agreement. Covers use of AI services, rights in input and output, intellectual property and privacy, and AI-related disclaimers.
